item.title: 'Survivor 50': Savannah Louie voted out as Rick Devens plants fake idol at Tribal Council
item.description: Survivor: 'Survivor 50': Savannah Louie voted out as Rick Devens plants fake idol at Tribal Council. Survivor featured the Cila tribe voting out Savannah Louie, who won Survivor 49, and Rick Devens planting a fake idol at Tribal Council during the Season 50 episode that aired Wednesday night on CBS.

item.title: 'Survivor 50's Savannah Louie explains why she didn't play Shot in the Dark despite believing she was being voted off
item.description: Survivor: 'Survivor 50's Savannah Louie explains why she didn't play Shot in the Dark despite believing she was being voted off. Survivor 50 eliminee Savannah Louie has explained why she didn't play her "Shot in the Dark" at Tribal Council despite believing it was nearly certain she was going to be voted out of the game.
